label: No placebo
rationale: This is a randomized crossover comparison of cycling with VirtualPark versus cycling without virtual reality. The control arm is described as standard cycling training, not a placebo or sham drug comparator, so the study supports no placebo use.

evidence.quote: compare cycling training performed with and without virtual reality
Non-virtual reality condition (No-VR): cycling training alone without virtual reality
standard cycling training using the ergometer

title: Evaluation of the Impact of Virtual Park on Training Motivation in Adult Patients

rule.label: No placebo
